An '''hydroelectric power generator''' was a form of aquatic [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]] used to power bases and strongholds.

Requiring a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] readily available near, around, or under the installation in question; strong currents would power the hydroelectric generator and in turn power the base, providing an relatively cheap and plentiful energy supply.
